units.source_text: 六条院源氏也常常派人来探望，并将亲自去访。

en.t: Lord Genji of Rokujo often sent people to inquire after him as well, and was soon to visit in person.

units.source_text: 朱雀院闻知源氏即将亲自前来问病，不胜欣喜。

en.t: When Suzaku-in heard that Genji would soon come personally to ask after his illness, he was overjoyed.

units.source_text: 恰巧夕雾中纳言来了，朱雀院便把他召入帘内，和他详谈：

en.t: Just then Yugiri, the Middle Counselor, arrived, so Suzaku-in summoned him inside the blinds and spoke with him at length:

units.source_text: “桐壶先帝将崩之时，曾嘱咐我许多遗言。

en.t: When the late Emperor Kiritsubo was near death, he entrusted many last wishes to me.

units.source_text: 就中特别叮咛的，是令尊之事和皇上之事。

en.t: Among them, what he stressed most especially concerned your honored father and His Majesty.

units.source_text: 但我即位之后，便觉政令往往遭受限制，不能事事如意称心。

en.t: But after I took the throne, I found that government orders were often constrained, and not everything could go as I wished.

units.source_text: 因此内心之爱虽未变更，而略一错失，便获罪于令尊。

en.t: Thus, though my affection in my heart never changed, one small misstep was enough to make me guilty in your father's eyes.

units.source_text: 岂知多年以来，不论为了何事，令尊对我都无怀恨之色。

en.t: Yet over all these years, no matter what the matter was, your father never showed the slightest sign of bearing me a grudge.

units.source_text: 凡人虽极贤明，倘逢不利于己之事，往往异常动心，必然设法报复，因而发生意外之变。

en.t: Ordinary people, however wise and enlightened, are often deeply stirred when something works against them, and are sure to seek revenge, bringing about unforeseen calamities.

units.source_text: 即在古昔圣代，此种事例亦屡见不鲜。

en.t: Even in the sage ages of antiquity, such examples were by no means rare.

units.source_text: 为此世人正在疑虑，以为有朝一日，令尊必将向我泄愤。

en.t: For that reason people were suspicious, thinking that one day your father would surely vent his anger on me.

units.source_text: 岂知他终于容忍到底；不但如此，又且真心照拂我儿皇太子，

en.t: Yet he endured it to the end; not only that, he also cared sincerely for my son, the Crown Prince,

units.source_text: 最近复遣明石女公子入宫为太子妃，于是我们两家亲上加亲。

en.t: and recently sent the young lady of Akashi into the palace as the Crown Prince's consort, so that our two houses became closer than ever.

units.source_text: 我心感激，实无限量。

en.t: The gratitude in my heart is truly beyond measure.

units.source_text: 但因本性愚昧，深恐为爱子之心所迷，而做有失体统之举，

en.t: But because I am foolish by nature, I greatly feared being led astray by love for my child and doing something unbecoming,

units.source_text: 故对于太子，我自己故意装作漠不关心，一任别人安排。

en.t: and so, regarding the Crown Prince, I deliberately pretended indifference and left everything to others to arrange.

units.source_text: 对于皇上，则谨遵先皇遗言，即将皇位让与。

en.t: As for His Majesty, I reverently obeyed the late Emperor's will and yielded the throne to him.

units.source_text: 且喜他能在这末劫之世当个英明之主，挽回了我在位时的颓风，合我本意，无任欣慰。

en.t: I am also delighted that in this latter age he has become a wise ruler, restoring what had declined during my reign; it accords with my deepest wish and gives me boundless comfort.

units.source_text: 自从今秋行幸六条院之后，我回思往日之事，不胜依恋，颇思与令尊促膝谈心。

en.t: Since the imperial visit to Rokujo-in this autumn, I have looked back on former days with deep longing and have very much wished to sit close with your father and speak heart to heart.

units.source_text: 务望贤侄代为劝驾，请他早日亲自惠临。”

en.t: I earnestly hope, my worthy nephew, that you will urge him on my behalf and ask him to come in person soon.

units.source_text: 他说时神态异常萎靡。

en.t: As he spoke, his appearance was extraordinarily weak and dispirited.

units.source_text: 夕雾奏复：“侄儿年幼，远昔之事不得而知。

en.t: Yugiri answered respectfully, I was young, and so I cannot know about those distant past events.

units.source_text: 稍长以后，参与朝廷政治，处理种种世务，

en.t: After I grew somewhat older, I took part in court government and handled various worldly affairs,

units.source_text: 其间关于大小政事，又或关于私人事宜，

en.t: and during that time, whether the matters concerned major or minor affairs of state, or private concerns,

units.source_text: 常有机会与家父共同商谈，然而从来不曾听见他暗示对伯父怀有旧恨。

en.t: I often had chances to consult together with my father, yet I never once heard him hint that he bore any old resentment toward my uncle.

units.source_text: 反之，他曾言道：‘朱雀院中途辞退了皇上的保护人之职，

en.t: On the contrary, he once said: Suzaku-in resigned midway from the role of guardian to His Majesty,

units.source_text: 欲专心静修而笼闭深山，此后对世事全不闻问，

en.t: wishing to devote himself entirely to quiet religious practice and shut himself away deep in the mountains, and from then on he paid no attention at all to worldly affairs.

units.source_text: 这便不能遵行桐壶先帝的遗言了。

en.t: In that case, he cannot be said to have carried out the late Emperor Kiritsubo's will.

units.source_text: 他在位之时，我年龄还小，才能又差，加之上面贤能出人甚多，

en.t: When he was on the throne, I was still young and my abilities were poor, and besides, there were many capable and worthy people above me.

units.source_text: 故我虽欲为他效劳，而未能遂愿。

en.t: Therefore, although I wished to serve him, I could not fulfill that desire.

units.source_text: 如今朱雀院屏去政事，闲居静处，

en.t: Now Suzaku-in has set political affairs aside and lives quietly in retirement,

units.source_text: 我颇思开诚解怀，向他畅谈衷曲，并且亲聆教益。

en.t: and I very much wish to open my heart, speak freely to him of my deepest feelings, and hear his instruction in person.

units.source_text: 但为身份所限，行动甚不自由，以致迁延至今，未得谋面。

en.t: But because I am constrained by my position, my movements are very restricted, and so the matter has dragged on until now without my being able to meet him.

units.source_text: ’家父常说此话，并且叹息不置呢。”

en.t: My father often said this, and would sigh over it without end.
